relationships.subject: CTRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: CTRP3 alleviates mechanical allodynia and cold hyperalgesia in male SNI rats by activating spinal SIRT1, which in turn enhances PGC-1α-mediated mitochondrial biogenesis and ATF5-induced UPRmt

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: EX-527 blocked the rCTRP3-induced increase in PGC-1α expression in spinal dorsal horn neurons of SNI rats

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: EX-527 inhibited the rCTRP3-induced increase in ATF5 expression in spinal dorsal horn neurons of SNI rats

relationships.subject: PGC-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: PGC-1α siRNA significantly inhibited the rCTRP3-evoked upregulation of ATF5 in spinal dorsal horn neurons

relationships.subject: CTRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings confirm that CTRP3 can alleviate SNI-induced oxidative stress in the spinal cord of rats.

key_findings: Spinal neuronal CTRP3 is reduced after SNI; intrathecal rCTRP3 relieves allodynia
Analgesia depends on SIRT1, PGC-1α and ATF5 (mitochondrial biogenesis and UPRmt)
